kind: P1 S2 perf tripwire (docs/v8-chase-p1-plan-2026-10-15.txt, S2 exit gate)
machine: crystal: aarch64 Linux, Cortex-X925 (CPUs 5-9, 15-19) + Cortex-A725; every process pinned to CPU 5

builds.main: e3310993 (main = the branch's merge base), release profile, --features embed
builds.rc: rearch/v8-chase d6ef1e66 + the S2 exit-gate commit that adds this record, release profile, --features embed (counted build)
builds.gc: rearch/v8-chase d6ef1e66 + the S2 exit-gate commit that adds this record, release profile, --features embed,gc-heap (Tier::Jit is admitted as bytecode)

release_profile: opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1, panic abort
method: fresh processes, interleaved: every round runs each config once, the starting config rotating per round; wall from a monotonic clock around fork/exec/wait4, CPU and peak RSS from wait4

initial_run_64MiB_floor.note: the first tripwire run, before the gc-heap byte-budget floor went from 64 MiB to 8 MiB; same method, same main and rc binaries, gc = the earlier gc-heap build

collection_floor_sweep.note: gc-heap build before the floor change (js-gcx = 64 MiB default plus the TRUST_JS_GC_MIN_HEAP_BYTES override); f<N> = floor N MiB; main = e3310993; all runs with TRUST_JS_PERF_METRICS=1, 3 rounds
